question: Tell me the most purchased other products and their quantities by customers who bought the Google Red Speckled Tee each month for the three months starting from November 2020.
sql:
-- Top other product per month for customers who bought Red Speckled Tee
WITH red_tee_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date), MONTH) AS purchase_month,
    user_pseudo_id,
    ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(items) AS item
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase' 
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ecommerce.transaction_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND ecommerce.transaction_id != '(not set)'
    AND item.item_name = 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
),
all_purchases_by_red_tee_buyers AS (
  SELECT 
    rtb.purchase_month,
    e.user_pseudo_id,
    e.ecommerce.transaction_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.quantity
  FROM red_tee_buyers rtb
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e
    ON rtb.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), MONTH) = rtb.purchase_month
    AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.items) AS i
  WHERE i.item_name != 'Google Red Speckled Tee'
),
product_quantities AS (
  SELECT 
    purchase_month,
    item_name,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM all_purchases_by_red_tee_buyers
  GROUP BY purchase_month, item_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    purchase_month,
    item_name,
    total_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY purchase_month ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, item_name) AS rn
  FROM product_quantities
)
SELECT 
  purchase_month,
  item_name,
  total_quantity
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY purchase_month
